design_source_of_truth.location: src/local_llm_server/static/design-system.css + src/local_llm_server/static/brand.css + src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*.{css,js}; durable visual/product-language intent in docs/brand-guidelines.md

primary_users: developers and technical users operating local AI models
engineers evaluating runtime capability resource behavior and model configurations
primary_jobs: understand within seconds whether the local AI control plane is ready, what is resident and whether resource pressure affects the next action
choose a task first and execute it with a compatible local runtime without reasoning about unnecessary backend plumbing
manage multiple resident runtimes within a bounded AI resource budget and understand the feasibility and consequences of loading another model
inspect evaluation evidence, runtime identity and resource behavior truthfully without confusing observed estimated configured and unavailable values
recover safely from unsupported configurations runtime failures resource pressure and insufficient capacity
primary_surfaces: model and runtime lifecycle management surfaces
task-first playground and endpoint integration surfaces
experience_context.product_role: A calm local AI control plane for runtime lifecycle resource decisions task execution observability and evidence; not a chatbot frontend or generic monitoring dashboard.

overview.primary_question: Can I use local AI now and is anything constraining the next action?
primary_information: AI resource budget used and headroom
secondary_information: compact workload trend when it adds decision value

models_and_runtimes.primary_question: What can run what is resident and what will happen to resources if I change residency?
primary_information: AI budget resident footprint reserved capacity and headroom
orthogonal artifact runtime route and policy state
load unload pin reload and default-route actions
models_and_runtimes.detail_pattern: Keep the inventory context visible and open model/runtime detail in a drawer or equivalent contextual surface.

endpoints.primary_question: How do I use the stable local application contract and which runtimes can satisfy it?
primary_information: copyable cURL Python JavaScript and other supported examples
secondary_information: input output streaming and structured-output contract details

playground.primary_question: Can I execute this task locally with this model and configuration and what happened?
primary_information: compatible cold models with explicit Load & use
secondary_information: latency throughput token and memory evidence when available

benchmark_and_evaluation.primary_question: Which model/runtime is the best fit for this scenario on this machine and is the comparison reproducible?
secondary_information: best quality fastest lowest-memory and other dimension-specific callouts

system.primary_question: What is the server and runtime environment doing and where is a problem occurring?

settings.primary_question: Which local policies and effective values govern this control plane?

task_execution.capability_source: server-provided task and capability descriptors; model-name heuristics are not an accepted source of truth

accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA for the browser control-plane surface

priority_order: narrow and small viewport essential monitoring and intentional actions

design_system.component_source: src/local_llm_server/static/design-system.css + src/local_llm_server/static/brand.css with source-backed renderers under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*.js and components.js

critical_journeys.name: Open the control plane, understand truthful readiness runtime and resource status and navigate through refresh-stable core routes
Configure a supported text request, submit inference, observe progress or failure and recover for the next request without stale poisoned state
Understand model artifact residency route policy and resource state, assess load feasibility and perform an intentional runtime-management action
Start or review evaluation state and inspect dimension-specific comparable result and identity evidence without confusing unavailable data with zero
Complete a product run and leave no project-owned listener process temporary state or unbounded diagnostic residue

reference_views: implemented control-plane shell and overview sources under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*
implemented Korgis task execution and configuration sources in src/local_llm_server/static/index.html with runtime brand bootstrap in config.js/brand.css and control-plane capability renderers
Models & Runtimes is the canonical lifecycle and multi-model resource-decision surface; legacy lifecycle controls are transitional and must not remain a second coherent product flow
critical loading empty error disabled warning resource-pressure and status source states covered by tests/e2e and tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py

validation.accessibility_automation: pytest -q tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py plus Playwright critical-journey assertions
validation.visual_regression: n/a for current unstable/incidental pixels; semantic visual contracts and design-system drift are blocking, pixel baselines are added only for stable high-risk surfaces
